summary: Organizes 2 tabs (MACHINES and SPARES) with 3 rules.
stages: STATUS stages, in order: IN-PROCESS (contains “PROCESS”), COMPLETED (contains “COMPLET”), DISPUTED (contains “DISPUT”), DISPATCHED (contains “DISPATCH”) and CANCELLED (contains “CANCEL”); any other value sorts last with plain formatting.

rules.headline: Keep every tab with a STATUS column sorted by STATUS stage (IN-PROCESS → COMPLETED → DISPUTED → DISPATCHED → CANCELLED; anything else last) then by DISPATCH DATE, oldest first, blanks last
rules.when: whenever STATUS, DISPATCH DATE or FREEZE? is edited

rules.headline: Color rows in every tab with a STATUS column
details: Where STATUS is IN-PROCESS: red (#FF0000) text.
Where STATUS is COMPLETED: green (#008000) text.
Where STATUS is DISPUTED: gold (#D4A017) text.
Where STATUS is CANCELLED: black (#000000) text, struck through.
Where STATUS is IN-PROCESS and DISPATCH DATE is before today: black (#000000) text on pink (#FCE4EC).
In the FREEZE? column, cells that are “YES”: green (#008000) text.
Each row starts as black (#000000) text, no fill; the rules above are applied in order, and a later match wins.

rules.headline: Rebuild the SUMMARY tab from every tab with a STATUS column
details: Columns are lined up by name across tabs.
A “SOURCE SHEET” column comes first, holding the source tab's name.
Empty “Type of Work” cells are filled with the source tab's name.
Sorted the same way as rule “sort_by_stage”.
Colored the same way as rule “status_formatting”.
Title banner: “CONSOLIDATED ORDER SUMMARY — ALL SHEETS”.
Locked against manual edits (it is rebuilt automatically).

guards: Rows with “!hold” set are never touched.
A run that would change more than 500 rows is stopped before writing anything.
If a header in a governed tab is renamed, the sheet pauses instead of running rules.
lines: Organizes 2 tabs (MACHINES and SPARES) with 3 rules.

STATUS stages, in order: IN-PROCESS (contains “PROCESS”), COMPLETED (contains “COMPLET”), DISPUTED (contains “DISPUT”), DISPATCHED (contains “DISPATCH”) and CANCELLED (contains “CANCEL”); any other value sorts last with plain formatting.

1. Keep every tab with a STATUS column sorted by STATUS stage (IN-PROCESS → COMPLETED → DISPUTED → DISPATCHED → CANCELLED; anything else last) then by DISPATCH DATE, oldest first, blanks last (whenever STATUS, DISPATCH DATE or FREEZE? is edited).
2. Color rows in every tab with a STATUS column (right after rule “sort_by_stage” runs).
- Where STATUS is IN-PROCESS: red (#FF0000) text.
- Where STATUS is COMPLETED: green (#008000) text.
- Where STATUS is DISPUTED: gold (#D4A017) text.
- Where STATUS is CANCELLED: black (#000000) text, struck through.
- Where STATUS is IN-PROCESS and DISPATCH DATE is before today: black (#000000) text on pink (#FCE4EC).
- In the FREEZE? column, cells that are “YES”: green (#008000) text.
- Each row starts as black (#000000) text, no fill; the rules above are applied in order, and a later match wins.
3. Rebuild the SUMMARY tab from every tab with a STATUS column (2 minutes after edits stop).
- Columns are lined up by name across tabs.
- A “SOURCE SHEET” column comes first, holding the source tab's name.
- Empty “Type of Work” cells are filled with the source tab's name.
- Sorted the same way as rule “sort_by_stage”.
- Colored the same way as rule “status_formatting”.
- Title banner: “CONSOLIDATED ORDER SUMMARY — ALL SHEETS”.
- Locked against manual edits (it is rebuilt automatically).
Rows with “!hold” set are never touched.
A run that would change more than 500 rows is stopped before writing anything.
If a header in a governed tab is renamed, the sheet pauses instead of running rules.
